title: Compounds
competency: Define a compound as two or more elements chemically combined.

keywords.def: A pure substance of two or more elements chemically combined.

en.text: A compound is a pure substance of two or more elements chemically combined. Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen. Each water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. Salt, carbon dioxide and sugar are also compounds.

screens.title: Table salt
screens.ask: Table salt is made of sodium and chlorine joined together. Is salt an element?
screens.after: Salt has two elements chemically combined. A substance like this is a compound.

screens.text: A compound is a pure substance.
screens.why: A compound is a pure substance of two or more elements.

screens.text: Calcium oxide is made from calcium and oxygen. Which statement is right?
opts: It is an element because it is pure
It is a compound: two elements chemically combined
It is a mixture of two gases
screens.ans: It is a compound: two elements chemically combined
screens.why: Pure substances can be elements or compounds. Calcium oxide has two elements joined, so it is a compound.
screens.clue: Pure does not always mean element.
